title: Stories: beginning, middle and end
examples: Teacher, where do I find the problem in a story?
Can you give me an example of a character?
What is the end part of a story?

explain.say: A story has three main parts you should know. These parts help us understand what happens.
The beginning tells us who the story is about. We meet the main characters here.

items: Characters are the people or animals.
They are who the story follows.
We meet them at the start.

explain.say: The middle part is where the main problem pops up. This is the exciting part.
The end is when the problem gets fixed. Everything settles down nicely.
For example, a little bear wants honey. The problem is he cannot reach the hive.

draw.text: Bear wants honey, but cannot reach it

explain.say: In real life, when you play a game, the beginning is getting ready. The middle is the action. The end is when you stop playing.

draw.text: Playing a game: start, action, stop

faq.q: What is a character in a story?
faq.a: A character is any person or animal that appears in the story. They are the ones who do the actions.
asks: Who are the people in the book?

faq.q: Where does the problem happen in a story?
faq.a: The problem usually happens in the middle part of the story. This is what makes the story exciting to read.
asks: When does the story get difficult?

faq.q: Does the end always fix the problem?
faq.a: Most stories do fix the problem by the end. This is called the resolution, and it makes the story feel complete.

faq.q: Can a story have a problem in the beginning?
faq.a: Sometimes a small problem starts early, but the big, main problem usually builds up in the middle section.
asks: Can the problem start right away?

faq.q: What is the difference between the middle and the end?
faq.a: The middle is where the action builds up to the biggest point. The end is the calm after the biggest point.

facts: Stories usually have a beginning, middle, and end.
Characters are the people or animals in the story.
The problem is the main challenge in the story's middle.
The end part shows how the problem is solved.

quiz.say: The main character wakes up and sees a big puddle.
quiz.why: The beginning sets the scene and introduces the character.

wrong.0: The middle is where the big action or problem starts.
wrong.1: The end is when the story wraps up and finishes.
wrong.2: Characters are who the story is about, not the part of the story.

quiz.say: The little puppy finally finds its way back to its family.
quiz.why: Finding the family is the final resolution of the story.

wrong.0: The beginning is when the puppy first got lost.
wrong.1: The middle is when the puppy was searching everywhere.
wrong.2: The problem is the feeling of being lost, not the ending.

quiz.say: The lost kitten cannot find its way home.
quiz.why: The struggle to find home is the main problem in the middle.

wrong.0: The end is when the kitten finally finds its way home.
wrong.1: Characters are the people, not the part of the story.
wrong.3: The beginning is when the kitten was happy at home.
